headline: Modern Warfare 4 reviews are in
title: Modern Warfare 4 Review Scores | GameSpot 8 out of 10 | Is MW4 Good | Call of Duty News
video_script: The reviews for Call of Duty Modern Warfare four are in, and they are mostly positive. GameSpot gave it eight out of ten. Reviewers liked the multiplayer maps and the campaign, which closes out Infinity Ward's Modern Warfare story. Some said it feels like more of the same. What score would you give it? Comment below!
description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 reviews are mostly positive; GameSpot scored it 8/10 (Metacritic). Critics praised the multiplayer maps and campaign.
